summary: CPS Technologies filed an 8-K reporting third-quarter fiscal 2026 results for the period ended September 26, 2026, via press release dated November 3, 2026. Revenue was $8.9 million, gross margin 20.9%, and operating profit $0.4 million, with margin expansion and record quarterly revenue cited. The company also disclosed receipt of its first order from a defense contractor for tungsten alloy components made using its proprietary QuickSet Injection Molding process, and noted finalizing plans for a new facility. No transaction, stake, price, or board recommendation is present; this is a routine earnings current report, not a special situation.
